trailhead.label: The car park on the hairpin just past Passo Rolle, the board’s start

cautions: The car park is on the SS50 hairpin at Passo Rolle: keep your dog on a short lead by the road.
Stony path on the open summit of Monte Castellazzo, with loose rock: watch your dog’s paws.
No shade and no shelter on the top: turn back if storms build.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
